name: gi-fixture
description: RFC 0011 GI fixtures: a converged, denoised flat lightmap baked with the gi-reference Cycles light paths (64 diffuse bounces, no clamping), with separated direct and indirect LMAP v2 layers, and a PRBV probe volume at 1 m spacing (tools/quality/probe_volume_bake.py). No reflection probe, no directional page and no pipeline reference render: the fixtures' Cycles references come from tools/quality/gi_reference.py and their oracles from tools/quality/gi_runtime.py.
